being selectable for runs and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored — this is why archive is a sub
-action rather than a DELETE. Requires `expectedRevision` — the revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the writ
e is re…\n- [Restore an archived environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/restore-an-archived-environment.m
d): Restore an archived environment. Returns 409 if another live environment took its name in the meantime. Plugin pins whose vers
ion row no longer exists at all are dropped on the way back to live — compare the returned `pluginVersionIds` against what you arc
hived to detect that. Requires `expectedRevi…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a
-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project — name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.
\n- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testin
g.md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment
returns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Deliberately NOT behind the beta gate that gu
ards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval po
licy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [
Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure
— but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them
in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberatel
y absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blo
bs are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These cap
s only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobod
y chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share lin
k and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while
`mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS
access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had — it takes effect at once rather than at exp
iry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-differen
t-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The al
ternative — unpublish and republish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage
breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's session
s used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extra
cted from the current window — and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones include
d — dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studi
es/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on
MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUEST
S and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempo
tent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md):
Keyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path nam
es the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Un
does a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record na
med `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secr
et) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence
is a deliber…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Rev
okes the grant at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected
. The server record — including its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with t
he same slug.\n- [List a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (i
nstalled, non-uninstalled) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, acti
vation, enable/disable and uninstall are app flows, not API operations.\n- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/plugins/get-a-plugin-version.md): One imported plugin version with its component projections: declared MCP servers (placemen
t, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is
membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the caller in this project: the project-shared o
nes plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whether its id is usable in an environment
's `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL
.md body. The body is mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which con
tent this read returned.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.
md): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the opera
